acquisition_method.evidence: The Orbitrap Astral was operated in positive mode using the data independent acquisition (DIA) mode.
experiment types: Data-independent acquisition; Bottom-up proteomics

alkylation_concentration.evidence: 30 µg protein aliquots were reduced (10 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine) and alkylated (50 mM iodoacetamide) for 30 min at ambient temperature.

alkylation_reagent.evidence: 30 µg protein aliquots were reduced (10 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine) and alkylated (50 mM iodoacetamide) for 30 min at ambient temperature.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Samples were subsequently processed by S-trap micro (Protifi) protocol according to the manufacturer’s instructions with 1.5 h 47°C tryptic (Sequencing Grade, Promega) digestion with 1:25 enzyme to substrate ratio.

collision_energy.evidence: Isolated precursors were fragmented in the HCD cell using 25% normalized collision energy.

fragmentation_method.evidence: Isolated precursors were fragmented in the HCD cell using 25% normalized collision energy.

instrument.evidence: Samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS using an EvosepOne LC system (Evosep Biosystems) connected to an Orbitrap Astral Mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a high-field asymmetric ion mobility spectrometry (FAIMS) Pro Duo interfaced with an EASY-Spray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

ionization_type.evidence: inferred: Samples were analyzed by LC-MS/MS using an EvosepOne LC system (Evosep Biosystems) connected to an Orbitrap Astral Mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) equipped with a high-field asymmetric ion mobility spectrometry (FAIMS) Pro Duo interfaced with an EASY-Spray source (Thermo Fisher Scientific).

labeling.evidence: inferred: Raw data were searched in DIA-NN v1.9.2 against an in silico predicted library previously generated from the UniProt human proteome database, plus common contaminants.

mass_analyzer.evidence: inferred: MS1 scans were acquired in the Orbitrap at 240-K resolution over m/z range from 380 to 980.

DIA MS2 scans were acquired in the Astral mass analyzer with nonoverlapping windows of 2 Th with precursor scan range from 380 to 980 m/z (299 MS2 scans per cycle) with a maximum injection time of 3 ms (maximum duty cycle of 0.6 s).

ptm.evidence: Cysteine carbamidomethylation was set as a fixed modification, with tryptic (Trypsin/P) peptides permitted with a maximum of one missed cleavage.

reduction_concentration.evidence: 30 µg protein aliquots were reduced (10 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine) and alkylated (50 mM iodoacetamide) for 30 min at ambient temperature.

reduction_reagent.evidence: 30 µg protein aliquots were reduced (10 mM Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine) and alkylated (50 mM iodoacetamide) for 30 min at ambient temperature.
